title: Focus with a ref
summary: Reach a DOM node with `useRef`, and pass `ref` as a plain prop (React 19).
prompt: Finish `SearchBox`. "Focus search" focuses the "Search" input. "Clear" empties it and focuses it again. Then finish `FancyInput`: in React 19, `ref` is an ordinary prop, so forward it to the `<input>`.
hints: Create the ref with `useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)`, attach it with `ref={inputRef}`, and call `inputRef.current?.focus()`.
In React 19, a function component can destructure `ref` from its props; it no longer needs `forwardRef`.
